title: Dreams In Frame
overview: Dreams In Frame is an inspiring Bangladeshi motivational talk and storytelling series produced and helmed by filmmaker Borhan Khan. Spanning two seasons released in 2021 and 2022—with eight episodes each—the series was created to encourage young people to dream big and pursue their ambitions. __ In every episode, the show features accomplished individuals and real-life achievers as guests, bringing their personal journeys, struggles, and triumphs to light. Through intimate conversations and sleek cinematic visuals, Dreams In Frame bridges the gap between role models and the youth. By sharing authentic stories of resilience and hard work, the series serves as an empowering platform that fuels ambition, offers practical wisdom, and inspires the next generation to turn their own dreams into reality.
